svg.aria-label: An instrument rack on a bench. On top, a request card stands in its slot next to a 19-position selector knob that has raised one of 19 workflow cards on the shelf below. Under the shelf, a rail holds six script modules. The cabinet at the bottom has six card drawers for the user's profile, experience, voice, market map, CV and change log; one drawer is pulled out, and the plunger of a dial gauge rests on its stack of nine cards, so the needle turns further the more cards there are. Cables run from ports on the cabinet to four tools on the bench: a browser screen, a ledger for the tracker, a mail tray and a printer with a one-page sheet.
svg.text: Request in at the top, your data at the bottom
